_doc: Allowed levers for the nightly experiment loop (experiment_loop.py). ONLY these levers and values can ever be applied. Order = test queue. Every value must render cleanly (hook/cta '' = no card; music_volume is the documentary music bed, default config.DOC_MUSIC_VOLUME 0.10). length 'short' (2026-11-12) = a 50-60 word script and a loop end; judged on views@72h, since a shorter video gets a higher % watched for free. length 'long' (2026-11-17) = a 190-220 word full case file (~70-80 s), also judged on views@72h; it runs before 'short'.

levers.hypothesis: Dropping the 1.8s hook title card (straight into the spoken cold open) raises avg % watched; research says a cold open beats a title card.

'long' first (autopilot 2026-11-17, stage 3 new format): a 70-80 s full case file (190-220 words: setup, the turn, the court outcome, the open question) gets more views than the 32-38 s video. Every post lands at ~700 views whatever its hold (n=52, 28 d), while UK true-crime TikTok accounts that break out tell whole cases over minutes (truecrimecaitlyn 50K-330K on 4-8 min, charleybournetruecrime 183K on 4 min). Then 'short': a 20-25 s case (50-60 words) whose end dissolves back into its first frame gets watched through and replayed.

A small place-and-year tag in the first 3 seconds (only when both are in the case's source) gives every video something of its own from the first frame, raising avg % watched and making videos less alike (view-cap research 2026-11-10).
Ending on the payoff line with no end card raises avg % watched (viewers leave at the outro).
A quieter music bed makes the narration clearer and raises avg % watched.
